A service containing only pass-through methods is redundant and should be retired.

Back to STX rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

A service containing only pass-through methods is redundant and should be retired. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the The Standard family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STX0003: A service containing only pass-through methods is redundant and should be retired.
internal interface IStudentProcessingService
{
    ValueTask<IQueryable<Student>> RetrieveStudents();
    ValueTask AddStudent(Student newStudent);
    ValueTask UpdateStudent(Student updatedStudent);
    ValueTask DeleteStudent(Student deletedStudent);
}

internal class StudentProcessingService(IStudentService studentService)
    : IStudentProcessingService
{
    public ValueTask<IQueryable<Student>> RetrieveStudents() =>
        studentService.RetrieveStudents();

    public ValueTask AddStudent(Student newStudent) =>
        studentService.AddStudent(newStudent);

    public ValueTask UpdateStudent(Student updatedStudent) =>
        studentService.UpdateStudent(updatedStudent);

    public ValueTask DeleteStudent(Student deletedStudent) =>
        studentService.DeleteStudent(deletedStudent);
}
